mapper.select: WITH candidates AS ( SELECT event.id FROM public.iam_outbox_event event WHERE event.is_deleted = false AND ( (event.status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY') AND event.next_retry_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) OR (event.status = 'PROCESSING' AND event.updated_time < #{processingExpiredBefore}) ) ORDER BY event.next_retry_time, event.id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT #{batchSize} ) UPDATE public.iam_outbox_event event SET status = 'PROCESSING', updated_by = 0, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = event.version + 1 FROM candidates WHERE event.id = candidates.id RETURNING event.id, event.event_id, event.aggregate_type, event.aggregate_id, event.tenant_id, event.event_type, event.schema_version, event.payload_json::text AS payload_json, event.retry_count, event.trace_id, event.occurred_time, event.version
mapper.update: UPDATE public.iam_outbox_event SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error_code = NULL, updated_by = 0, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND is_deleted = false

UPDATE public.iam_outbox_event SET status = CASE WHEN #{dead} THEN 'DEAD' ELSE 'RETRY' END, retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, updated_by = 0, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND is_deleted = false
